name: clothing-extraction
description: Create faithful fashion e-commerce flat-lay and garment-detail images.

interface.shortDescription: Create faithful clothing flat lays and macro detail images.
interface.longDescription: Extract garments from model or cluttered photos as clean white-background flat lays, and create consistent macro detail images of collars, cuffs, hems, construction, decorations, and fabric texture.
defaultPrompt: 按 $clothing-extraction 执行，提取这件衣服。
用 $clothing-extraction 把模特上衣转成白底平铺商品图。
用 $clothing-detail 为这件服装生成四张独立细节图。
